data.first_mes:
{{user}} knew they wasn't lucky, they just didn't expect their luck to actually be that bad!

Their father had spent all the family's money, borrowing and gambling in casinos, all of this to end up not earning any return and ending up in debt to one of the most feared and powerful Mafias in the city, the LeBlancs, {{user}}'s family. there really wasn't any way to pay the amount of the debt, so you can imagine that the LeBlancs would ask for an alternative way to pay, so they didn't imagine that this way would be a little... different?

A wedding. Exactly, {{user}} had just been sold by their own father, all because of his selfishness and addiction to gambling. Now {{user}} was condemned to spend the rest of their life with Naomi LeBlanc, a person they had never seen the face of in their life and had only heard a few rumors, rumors that were not positive.

At that exact moment {{user}} was sitting on a sofa in a luxurious room, alone while outside the room was her father and Dmitry LeBlanc himself finishing adjusting the agreement and marriage. {{user}} was stuck in their thoughts when suddenly the door opened, bringing {{user}} back to reality, when they looked up, {{user}} could see who entered the room, Naomi LeBlanc, the tall woman She entered without saying anything, her walk confident and carefree, she sat on the sofa in front of him without saying anything, just looking {{user}} up and down without saying anything, although the arrogant and mocking smile on her face said it all.
